prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet afternoon in a library reading room. On the far left, a tall oak bookshelf stands firmly against the wall, its shelves packed with leather-bound volumes. Next to this bookshelf sits a woman in a green cardigan, her posture relaxed as she leans back in a plush velvet armchair. A small terrier rests on her lap, curled into a tight ball of fur, sleeping soundly. The woman looks at an open hardcover book resting on her knees, her finger tracing the text. In the center of the room, a large wooden table dominates the space, covered in scattered papers and inkwells. A man in a red scarf sits at the head of this table, his elbows propped up as he writes vigorously in a journal. Beside him, a young girl in a yellow dress points at a map spread out before them, her expression curious. The man in the red scarf looks at the map, nodding slightly in response to her question. To the right of the table, a librarian in a blue apron walks past, carrying a stack of returned books. She hands a single volume to a student in a grey hoodie who waits patiently by the circulation desk. The student takes the book with both hands, smiling faintly. Behind the student, a potted fern adds a touch of greenery to the corner, its leaves drooping slightly from lack of water. Near the window on the right, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a wooden bench, watching the dust motes dance in the sunlight. A black cat sits next to him on the bench, grooming its paw with meticulous care. The elderly man looks at the cat, a gentle smile on his face. Above them, a brass chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its bulbs unlit but polished to a shine. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the room. There is no modern plastic furniture present in the scene.
